/**

 * TASK: Implement a Role-Based Post-Login Success Notification

 *

 * GOAL

 * ----

 * After a successful login, display a modern success notification

 * informing the user that login was successful and indicating

 * which dashboard they have been redirected to based on their role.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * DESIGN

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Use a premium toast notification (Sonner / Shadcn Toast).

 *

 * Position:

 * Top-right

 *

 * Style:

 * - White background

 * - Green success icon

 * - Soft shadow

 * - Rounded corners (16px)

 * - Smooth fade + slide animation

 * - Auto dismiss after 4 seconds

 *

 * ==========================================

 * LOGIN FLOW

 * ==========================================

 *

 * After authentication:

 *

 * 1. Retrieve the user's role from the database.

 * 2. Redirect to the appropriate dashboard.

 * 3. Display the success toast AFTER navigation completes.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * SUCCESS MESSAGES

 * ==========================================

 *

 * ADMIN

 *

 * Title:

 * "Welcome back, Administrator!"

 *

 * Description:

 * "Login successful. You have been redirected to the Admin Dashboard."

 *

 * ------------------------------------------

 *

 * DOCTOR

 *

 * Title:

 * "Welcome back, Doctor!"

 *

 * Description:

 * "Login successful. You have been redirected to your Doctor Dashboard."

 *

 * ------------------------------------------

 *

 * PATIENT

 *

 * Title:

 * "Welcome back!"

 *

 * Description:

 * "Login successful. You have been redirected to your Patient Dashboard."

 *

 * ==========================================

 * OPTIONAL PERSONALIZATION

 * ==========================================

 *

 * If the user's display name exists:

 *

 * "Welcome back, Dr. Ahmed!"

 *

 * or

 *

 * "Welcome back, Sarah!"

 *

 * Otherwise use the generic messages above.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * FIRST LOGIN

 * ==========================================

 *

 * If this is the user's first login:

 *

 * Title:

 * "Welcome to La Dune!"

 *

 * Description:

 * "Your account has been successfully created. Your dashboard is now ready."

 *

 * ==========================================

 * ERROR HANDLING

 * ==========================================

 *

 * If role is missing:

 *

 * Show error toast:

 *

 * Title:

 * "Account Error"

 *

 * Description:

 * "Unable to determine your account type. Please contact support."

 *

 * Do not redirect.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * UX

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Do not show duplicate notifications.

 *

 * Only display one success toast per login session.

 *

 * Wait until navigation is complete before displaying the toast.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * ACCESSIBILITY

 * ==========================================

 *

 * Toast must:

 *

 * - Be keyboard accessible.

 * - Have proper ARIA live region.

 * - Respect reduced motion settings.

 *

 * ==========================================

 * RESULT

 * ==========================================

 *

 * ✔ Modern premium success notification

 * ✔ Personalized welcome message

 * ✔ Role-aware redirect confirmation

 * ✔ First-login welcome message

 * ✔ Accessible and responsive

 * ✔ Clean integration with React + Supabase + Shadcn/Sonner

 */
